whatsapp.name: WhatsApp
whatsapp.shortDescription: Connect WhatsApp conversations to a Geem Expert.
whatsapp.description: Subscribe to a WhatsApp plan, install the app, then connect one or more WhatsApp numbers. Bind each connection to an Expert to answer inbound messages.

chat-widget.name: Chat Widget
chat-widget.shortDescription: Embed a Geem Expert chat widget on your website.
chat-widget.description: Subscribe monthly, install Chat Widget, bind one Expert for private RAG grounding, customize appearance, and paste a script tag on your site. Optional allowed origins restrict which domains can load the widget.

agents-ai.name: Agents AI
agents-ai.shortDescription: Add Geem RAG and model rounds to client-owned agent loops.
agents-ai.description: Use the OpenAI-compatible Agents AI endpoint from your own agent runtime. Your application executes tools; Geem supplies Expert policy, retrieval context, and model rounds.

mcp-connectors.name: MCP Connectors
mcp-connectors.shortDescription: Connect trusted remote MCP servers to Workspace Experts.
mcp-connectors.description: Discover remote MCP tools, classify and grant them per Expert, and require explicit approval for writes on public surfaces. Credentials and external identities are shared workspace resources.

chatWidget.title: Chat widget embed
chatWidget.groundingHint: Select a Geem Expert. Its knowledge grounds visitor answers and supplements Geem Core skills.
chatWidget.allowedOriginsHint: Optional. One https origin per line (exact match). Leave empty to allow any site.
chatWidget.embedHint: Add this script before the closing </body> tag on your site.
chatWidget.embedNote: Appearance updates apply automatically after saving — you do not need to change the script tag.
chatWidget.disconnectConfirm: Disable this widget and uninstall Chat Widget from the workspace?
chatWidget.needsExpert: Choose an Expert before embedding the widget on your site.
chatWidget.mcpSummary: Only tools explicitly bound to this exact widget for {{expert}} can run. An Expert-wide grant alone does not expose a tool publicly.
chatWidget.mcpOriginRequirement: MCP tools require at least one exact HTTPS allowed origin and show visitors an external-service disclosure.

connect.title: Connect WhatsApp
connect.description: Choose how you want to link this WhatsApp session to Geem.
connect.followInstructions: Finish the steps in WhatsApp, then keep this dialog open while Geem checks the connection.
connect.qrDescription: Use Linked Devices in WhatsApp to scan a QR code from this browser.
connect.pairingDescription: Enter your phone number and connect with an 8-character pairing code.

qr.title: Scan with Linked Devices
qr.instructions: Open WhatsApp on your phone and use Linked Devices to finish connection.
qr.step2: Go to Settings or Menu, then Linked Devices.
qr.step3: Tap Link a Device and scan this QR code.
qr.connected: WhatsApp is connected. You can close this dialog.
qr.waiting: Waiting for WhatsApp to become ready for QR.

pairing.title: Request a pairing code
pairing.instructions: Enter the phone number for this WhatsApp account, then use the pairing code on your device.
pairing.phoneHint: Use the full international number with country code.

connection.expertHint: This Expert answers incoming WhatsApp messages.
connection.emptyHint: Link a WhatsApp number to start receiving and answering messages.
connection.enabledHint: Allow this number to send and receive messages.
connection.autoReplyHint: Let the Expert answer incoming chats automatically.
connection.respondToGroupsHint: Also reply when this number is used in group chats.
connection.readOnly: Members can view WhatsApp connection settings but cannot change them.
connection.mcpSummary: Only tools explicitly bound to this exact WhatsApp connection for {{expert}} can run.
connection.mcpDirectOnly: MCP tools are available only in direct chats. Group, status, and broadcast conversations remain tool-free.
connection.mcpDisclosure: On first tool use, the sender is told that relevant message data may be sent to an external service. Write tools require a workspace operator.

statusHint.connecting: WhatsApp is still linking. Continue to finish setup.
statusHint.waitingForQr: Scan the QR code in WhatsApp to finish linking.
statusHint.disconnected: This session is offline. Reconnect to resume replies.
statusHint.actionRequired: WhatsApp needs attention before replies can continue.
statusHint.failed: Linking failed. Reconnect to try again.
